change: Added dedicated unblock reason exact-head-behind-base and predicate requires_source_reopen (separate from requires_repair_task). route_behind_results in scripts/git/auto_integrator.py publishes exact-head-behind-base requests via the content-addressed inbox with deterministic oldest-first ordering and enforces one outstanding BEHIND return per repository and target branch until the returned source task merges or is no longer open. In .orchestrator/supervisor.py, materialize_auto_integrator_unblock_requests revalidates under the canonical lock that the source task is still review_approved with matching generation and delivery_binding PR/head, then runs the canonical reopen transition as the reviewer with the fixed merge/diff instruction message without creating a child repair task.
not_changed: no child repair task created for BEHIND
activation: Requires runtime promotion by the coordinator after merge.
